digest.component_or_area: CLI command dispatch and bridge subsystem
propositions: rebar bridge-status and rebar purge-bridge CLI verbs are dead code with no active consumers and must be fully removed without deprecation shims
All implementation modules, schema definitions, help text, and test files specific to bridge-status and purge-bridge must be deleted
Active command documentation, CHANGELOG.md, and release notes must record the retirement; surviving bridge-alert warnings must provide neutral guidance without referencing removed commands
The dangling epic 3a03 citation in the retired bridge.py module must be removed along with the module itself
Both retired verbs must exit as unknown commands, absent from help output, with zero references in shipped package src/rebar and active command docs
